# The record of *intent*: which status checks the `default` branch ruleset
# (id 18226786) is meant to require. The live ruleset remains the authority
# — this file exists so a hand edit that drops or changes a check is
# detectable (scripts/check-required-checks-drift.sh,
# .github/workflows/required-checks-drift.yml) rather than found only by
# luck, as it was for issue #276. Whenever the ruleset is changed by hand
# (always an owner act — this pipeline holds no credential that can write
# it), mirror the change into this file in the same breath.
#
# One check per line: `context`, or `context @<integration_id>` when the
# check is pinned to a specific GitHub App. A pinned and an unpinned context
# are different entries — the pin is the security-relevant part, and
# dropping it silently is exactly the kind of change this file is for.
#
# `register` is intentionally absent: it was required until PR #220 retired
# the workflow that produced that context, and #256/#260 asked the owner to
# drop it from the ruleset so the merge queue would not wedge on a check
# that could never report again.

build
commit-format
Analyze (javascript-typescript)
Analyze (actions)
changelog-check @15368
changelog-section @15368
